_comment: One scenario = the stems that sum to one mix, judged together.
dry = the stem's raw input, before its fx chain.
wet = the stem's isolated contribution to the mix, after its fx chain (solo the
track and print it, with the chain active).
mix = what all the wet stems currently sum to.
All three must come from the same session state, or the model sees a
contradiction it was never trained on.
chain = the fx modules on that stem, in signal order. Allowed values:
eq, compressor, noisegate, distortion, reverb, delay, stereo_imager,
scenario_kind = 'subgroup' when the units are stems feeding a bus (the usual
case), 'full' when they are subgroup buses feeding the master.
Paths may be absolute, or relative to this manifest file.
Schema example only: the audio files it names are not shipped.
